note: Edgar County has no queryable zoning district layer. The county's zoning authority is limited to solar/wind ordinances. The county GIS (edgar-il.bhamaps.com, Bruce Harris & Associates) is a parcel/assessor viewer and its ArcGIS services return 403. The only city zoning found is Paris's 2014 static zoning map as PDF, with no GIS service. Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub found no official Edgar County or Paris zoning layer.
